title: Auto reviewer issuer replacement, delayed authorization and managed fallback can authorize stale work
cause: Review authorization did not retain the issuing service or enter its captured tool scope. Qualification could be revoked while directory/model work waited, and an equal-state replacement could authorize the tool. Final async authorization handed off after its last issuer check. Optional-authority presence did not establish or retain managed behavior before a reviewed call, including for already-pending local work.
implementation: Each review retains its original authority, verified tool participants and shared deployment classification. It enters runCaptured with the attested tool scope, uses instance-owned AsyncLocalStorage to reauthorize after capacity and at physical dispatch, and confirms the original issuer after downstream tool policies and the final asynchronous handoff. Caller/lifecycle cancellation wins. Optional authority presence remains managed after withdrawal; old local work is refused and unload uses Workspace write. Disposal joins active reviews before disabling the context.
